MUSAN (about 11 GB) not approved for download; deferred by decision.; Quality target: at most 8 false positives and at most 8 false negatives (rules text at the pinned commit and the public page).

status_meanings.BLOCKED: required asset, precision or backend contract absent
status_meanings.FINALIZED: checksum-verified final task-level protection campaign; scope remains as declared in its frozen plan
status_meanings.FROZEN_FOR_RUN: asset, source, cohort and scientific plan hashes sealed
status_meanings.IMPLEMENTING: source and fixture work underway; asset/backend smoke incomplete
status_meanings.READY: pinned asset and real-model fault backend passed engineering gate; effectiveness campaign may still be absent
